title: DSC compiled-artifact format
preamble:
# DSC compiled-artifact format

The compiler emits one `.dsc` file per `.ds` source file.
The runtime loads a `.dsc` into a single engine instance.
This doc specifies the `.dsc` on-disk format. Its companion
`.proto` files are in `proto/`.

**A `.dsc` carries one version: the DS version that compiled it**, in
`DscHeader.compiler_version`. A runtime accepts artefacts from its own
`<major>.<minor>.` series and rejects every other ([LDET.1.10]). A change to
what bytes mean therefore lands with a minor release, never inside a series,
because recordings made earlier in that series would stop replaying identically.
